g.text: Same seasonal sLIM for every model | Lower RMSE is better | No variant selected by 2015 skill
Standard PMM-SST and PMM-wind are the two canonical MCA expansion coefficients, not regional proxy indices.
All models are refitted within the labeled training period; PMM evolves freely after initialization.
Five overlapping starts and nine monthly leads represent one event, so these bars have no independent-event confidence intervals.
